title: Resource journal silently drops startup interval measurement
reproduction: Run hosted startup diagnostic37230193583 atd0e1e560 with frozen development240.
Compare RESOURCE_STARTUP_INTERVAL_BRACKET stdout event to the same timestamp in hosted-startup-37230193583-1.jsonl.
Observe stdout contains bracket timestamps and CPU deltas; durable journal contains only schema/at/runId/code. Alternatively write the same event through openResourceJournal and read persisted JSON.
expected: The durable sanitized journal retains the diagnostic measurement or explicitly rejects invalid measurement data; credentials, arguments and environment remain excluded.
actual: JOURNAL_FIELDS omits bracket and silently drops the complete measurement. Console event retained enough evidence to recover this run.
severity: S2: loss of diagnostic evidence; not a product failure
priority: P1: repair before another diagnostic run

transition_history.reason: Observed durable event missing bracket in actual run.
Confirmed writer field allowlist strips the field; stdout has original event.
Assigned bounded serializer repair with actual writer/readback regression.
